texte.spiel.unter: Prototype. The arena is not built yet, but the graves are already reserved.
texte.spiel.bereit: Ready. Nothing to do yet, which is the most honest job in the empire.
texte.welt.wartet: The world is being hammered into shape …
texte.welt.tippen: Drag to wander, pinch or use + and − to zoom, tap the ground to ask what it is.
texte.welt.leer: Nothing there yet. The gods are still drawing.
texte.welt.ausfall: The map painter has died ({e}). The world goes on, unseen.
texte.welt.globus: The whole world. Drag to spin it, tap to go there, pinch to come back down.
texte.fp.tippen: Left thumb: walk (push far to run). Right: swipe to turn. Tap a thing to ask what it is. PC: WASD, Q/E, mouse, Shift runs.
texte.fp.globus: Zoom in first. Even a gladiator cannot stand on the whole planet.
texte.fp.keinBoden: No dry ground here. The gladiator refuses to be a fish.
texte.fp.nichts: Air. Very nice air, but not a thing.
texte.mess.fp: first person {w}×{h}, sight {s} fields: {n} pictures, mean {m}, p95 {p}, {o} things drawn; window p95 {a} ({k} windows, {c} new pieces)
texte.mess.karte: Map: {s} pieces known · {n} ground images ({b}) · {g} drawn in the picture core, avg {a}, max {m} · frame draw avg {z}, max {x} · {e} stand-ins in view
texte.spiel.bodenInfo: Only approved objects appear here. Everything else is a grey stand-in until the Master Editor lets it through.
texte.spiel.tippen: Tap an object to read about it.
texte.spiel.ersatzInfo: This object is still a sketch. It waits in the Master Editor like a recruit waits for his first fight: nervously and without pay.
texte.stimme.laedt: The narrator is clearing his throat …
texte.stimme.gruss: Welcome, lanista. I am your narrator. Touch anything, and I will tell you about it. Even the dead ones.
texte.stimme.fehlt: The narrator has lost his voice: {e}
texte.mess.stimmeAus: Voice: not loaded. It costs nothing until you switch it on.
texte.mess.stimme: Voice ({a}): first sentence with loading {lade} · last sentence {rechen} for {dauer} of speech · {n} computed in the background, {c} from memory
texte.uhr.wartet: The world core is waking up …
texte.uhr.pausiert: Paused. Even death has to wait.
texte.uhr.ueberlast: The world is running behind. Time itself is out of breath.
texte.uhr.ausfall: A core has died ({e}). The world stands still until you reload. At least nobody else dies in the meantime.
texte.mess.kern: World core: {h} helper cores · tick mean {m}, p95 {p} · {n} ticks · {v} ticks lost · fingerprint {f}
texte.mess.kopiert: Copied. Paste it into the chat.
texte.spiel.wieder: The last save was damaged, so the one before it was used. A few minutes of history were quietly buried.
texte.start.unter: Choose a slot. Each holds one world, one ludus and an alarming number of future graves.
texte.start.keinSpeicher: This browser refuses to keep anything. You can play, but the world is forgotten the moment you leave.
texte.start.leer: Empty. Not even the rats have moved in yet.
texte.start.frageNeu: Start a new world here? The old one will be gone for good. Nobody will mourn it, except maybe you.
texte.start.frageLoeschen: Delete this slot for good? There is no grave for deleted worlds.
texte.start.neuer: Made by a newer version of the game. It is not loaded and will not be overwritten. Reload the page to get the new version.
texte.start.alt: From the days when the world was flat. It has since been bent into a globe and this save no longer fits. Delete it and start a new world.
texte.start.kaputt: This save is damaged and cannot be read. It was not changed. You can delete it.
texte.start.andererTab: Open in another tab. One world, one lanista: close the other tab first.
texte.neu.name: Name of your ludus
texte.neu.dichteInfo.thin: Few villages and towns. Long roads, lonely nights, cheap land.
texte.neu.dichteInfo.medium: A sensible number of villages and towns. Recommended for lanistae who like neighbours, but not too many.
texte.neu.dichteInfo.dense: Villages everywhere. More trade, more roads, more people who might complain about the screaming.
texte.neu.seedInfo: Leave it empty for a random world. The same seed always makes the same world, so you can share it. Words work too.
texte.speicher.ohne: Not saving: this browser keeps nothing.
texte.speicher.voll: Saving failed: the storage is full. Your last save is still intact. Free some space, the world keeps trying.
texte.speicher.neuer: Saving stopped: a newer version of the game has written this slot. Reload the page.
texte.speicher.fehler: Saving failed ({e}). Your last save is still intact. The world keeps trying.
texte.mess.speicher: Save: slot {n} · {m} saves · {b} · main thread {h} · core {k} · {g} · error {f}
texte.mess.speicherAus: Save: none (test mode or no storage).
texte.wahl.unterErde: Pinch or use − / + to zoom from the whole world down to single fields. Tap to mark your spot.
texte.wahl.unterRegion: Tap where your ludus should stand. Dry land only; the arena floor gets wet enough later.
texte.wahl.fehlt: The map painter is not ready. Try again in a moment.
texte.wahl.platzLeer: {b}. No settlement nearby. Peace and quiet, for now.
texte.wahl.verschoben: Moved to the nearest dry ground.
texte.wahl.nass: Water. Gladiators sink. Pick dry land.
texte.wahl.eis: Ice. Nothing grows here except regret. Pick somewhere warmer.
texte.wahl.keinLand: The gods found no land at all. Suspicious.
texte.bau.wahl: Pick what to build. Until then the map moves freely, so you can pretend there is a plan.
texte.bau.hilfe.lager: Storage: drag a floor with one finger. Walls, roof and a door come by themselves. Drag next to a storage to make it bigger. Two fingers move and zoom.
texte.bau.hilfe.werkstatt: Workshop: drag a floor with one finger. Walls, roof and a door come by themselves. Drag next to a workshop to make it bigger. Splinters are free.
texte.bau.hilfe.unterkunft: Lodging: drag a floor with one finger. Walls, roof and a door come by themselves. Drag next to a lodging to make it bigger. Comfort is extra and not available.
texte.bau.hilfe.abriss: Demolish: drag over what you built. Nothing comes back, except what was never started.
texte.bau.zuGross: Too big. At most {n} tiles at once; the architects faint easily.
texte.bau.ok: Planned for {g} gold. The builders are on their way, at their own pace.
texte.bau.okAb: Torn down. The rubble thanks you.
texte.bau.grund.not_flat: Not flat here. Levelling comes later; until then, find a flatter patch.
texte.bau.grund.water: Water. The fish refuse to move out.
texte.bau.grund.road: A road runs here. Traders get upset when you wall them in.
texte.bau.grund.nature: Trees or rocks in the way. They were here first.
texte.bau.grund.occupied: Something else is already built here.
texte.bau.grund.edge: The world ends here. Build somewhere less final.
texte.bau.grund.too_far: Too far from where you are looking. Move closer.
texte.bau.grund.no_gold: Not enough gold. Even slaves ask for bricks.
texte.bau.grund.too_many_sites: Too many building sites at once. Let the builders finish something first.
texte.bau.grund.room_too_big: That room would be too big. Split it up.
texte.bau.grund.no_world: The world is not ready yet.
texte.bau.hilfe.wand: Wall: drag a straight line along the tile edges. Gaps get walls; a line that is already all wall comes down instead. Doors stay where they are.
texte.bau.hilfe.tuer: Door: tap a wall. Tap again for a gate, once more and it is a wall again. Nobody said architecture was decisive.
texte.bau.hilfe.dach: Roof: drag over a building. Roof on the first tile? Off it comes, and you have a courtyard. Otherwise it goes on. Free; the rain is not.
texte.bau.hilfe.huelle: Rebuild walls: tap a building. Every open edge gets its wall back, and a door if none is left.
texte.bau.zuLang: Too long. At most {n} walls at once; the masons have to sleep sometime.
texte.bau.vorschauDach: {n} × {m} tiles · release to open or close the roof
texte.bau.okWand: {n} walls planned for {g} gold. Good fences make obedient neighbours.
texte.bau.okWandAb: {n} walls torn down. Fresh air, free of charge.
texte.bau.okTuer.tuer: Door planned. Now they can leave. Or try.
texte.bau.okTuer.tor: Gate planned. Wide enough for a cart, or a crowd running away.
texte.bau.okTuer.wand: Walled up again. Whoever was outside stays outside.
texte.bau.okHuelleLeer: Nothing to rebuild. This one is already a proper box.
texte.bau.tippWand: Tap a wall, not the floor. The floor does not open.
texte.bau.tippHaus: Tap a building. Open fields have no walls to fix.
texte.bau.grund.dead_end: That would wall in the only way out. The builders like to go home in the evening.
texte.bau.grund.no_wall: No wall here. A door needs something to sit in.
